description: Job Title: 1st Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) Job Description The 1st Shift Quality Assurance Analyst (Float Role) ensures that products consistently meet the highest standards of quality and safety in alignment with industry regulations and internal policies. This role supports multiple areas of the facility, performing audits, inspections, and testing to verify compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and state regulations. The analyst plays a key role in maintaining food safety programs, verifying documentation, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and uphold a strong quality culture. Responsibilities Perform routine quality assurance and quality control activities across designated production areas during 1st shift as a float resource. Conduct inspections and case audits to verify product quality, labeling accuracy, and adherence to specifications and standards. Verify Certificates of Analysis (COAs) for incoming materials and finished products to ensure they meet defined quality and safety requirements. Execute microbiological testing and environmental monitoring activities to assess product and facility hygiene conditions. Support and maintain compliance with GMP, SQF, HACCP, FDA, and applicable state regulations through daily oversight and documentation. Monitor and verify critical control points within HACCP plans to ensure food safety controls function effectively. Review batch records and related quality documentation for completeness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Conduct self-inspections, internal audits, and mock recalls to test the effectiveness of quality and food safety systems. Participate in root cause analysis for quality and food safety issues, and help implement corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate closely with operations, sanitation, maintenance, and other teams to resolve quality concerns and improve processes. Document quality findings, deviations, and inspection results clearly and accurately in accordance with company procedures. Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, food safety, and overall compliance. Assist in maintaining and updating quality and food safety documentation, including procedures, records, and audit reports. Be available to provide quality support during audits or food safety emergencies, including occasional overtime and weekend coverage when needed. Essential Skills Experience in quality assurance and quality control within a regulated manufacturing or food production environment. Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and their application in daily operations. Hands-on experience with inspection and quality analysis activities in a production or laboratory setting. Practical understanding of HACCP principles, including monitoring and verification of critical control points.
